units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 10:2">B. Mets. X, 2</cite>, v. <cite ref="M02094"><he>מַעֲזִיבָה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 117a:11">Ib. 117ᵃ</cite> <he>בחוזק ת׳ קמפלגי</he> (read: <he>בחַזּוּקֵי</he>) they differ as to whether the cement is for strengthening the ceiling (or for levelling the upper floor). Y. ib. X, beg. 12ᶜ <he>התחתון נותן ת׳ ולווחים</he> the owner of the lower story must furnish the joists and the boards.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1:6">Ex. R. s. 1<sup>6</sup></cite> <he>לפי שהם תִּקְרַת העולם זה שמתקן ת׳ וכ׳</he> because they (the tribes) are the ceiling of the world; he that arranges the joists properly puts the thick side of one beam by the thinner side of the other; Tanḥ. Sh’moth 3 <he>תִּקְרָתוֹ של עולם</he> (not <he>תקרתן</he>); a. fr.
